Named optional @esbuild/darwin-arm64@0.28.0 saves npm:null@* instead of native npm ^0.28.0. Next installation also encounters the unsupported-alias ceiling unnecessarily. Sweep other post-selection throws inside both registry and lockfile sources, including lifecycle/shadow admission, without inferring a version from request text.
